business_summary.text: Gandhar Oil Refinery (India) Limited is a leading manufacturer of specialty oils, offering white oils, petroleum jelly, lubricants, and process oils with manufacturing facilities in India and the UAE.

call_points.text: First-half PIO volumes grew 23% year-on-year, supported by demand from transformer, power, and rubber industries.
Gross margin spread sustained at ₹29,128 per kl, 3.0x year-on-year and in line with Q1 FY27.
CRISIL reaffirmed A+/Stable and A1 ratings; rated bank facilities enhanced to ₹1,014 crore.
PHPO segment continues as primary growth driver with 18% YoY volume growth
Gross margin spread expanded to ₹28,145 per kilolitre from ₹8,274 YoY due to agile sourcing and inventory management
Stand-alone company remains debt-free with borrowings primarily at overseas subsidiary Texol
Management declined to give specific forward-looking revenue guidance, but expects to maintain healthy EBITDA margins around current levels.
Gross margin spread for Q4 FY26 stood at ₹9,351 per kL, and full year gross margins improved to 11.48%.
Standalone debt-to-equity remains practically nil, supported by strong reserves and surplus.
Middle East geopolitical tensions and temporary closure of Hamriyah port impacted Sharjah plant operations, though local sourcing mitigated supply issues.

operating_notes.text: Completed purchase of land parcel admeasuring 18,353 sq. mtrs. in Silvassa for ₹2.28 Cr.
Received favourable order from Commissioner of Customs (Appeals) for ₹22.92 Cr refund relating to 2018-19 and 2019-20.
Received favourable order from Deputy Commissioner of Customs for ₹17.69 Cr refund relating to 2017-18.
Total installed manufacturing capacity across all 3 plants is 5,97,403 kL, with FY26 production volume at 5,54,212 kL (93% utilization).
Export volumes increased by 54% YoY, contributing 51% of total revenue
PHPO segment registered 18% YoY growth, driven by demand from personal care, healthcare and pharmaceutical sector
Company's capacity utilization stood at 97% across all three plants
Appointed Mr. Santosh Kumar Singh as Factory Manager of Silvassa plant.
Silvassa Unit No. 2 operations restored in early August after July flood disruptions.
Completed debottlenecking programme during Q2FY27 to strengthen operating capacity.

timeline.summary: Gandhar Oil completed the sale of land in Mohali, Punjab for ₹1.61 Cr.
Aslesh Ramesh Parekh, on behalf of Gandhar Oil Refinery’s promoters, declared no encumbrances on shares for FY2025-26 on April 03, 2026.
On May 6, 2026, Gandhar Oil completed the purchase of an 18,353 sq. mtr. land parcel in Silvassa for ₹22.78 Cr.
Gandhar Oil received a favourable customs appeal order on May 6, 2026, sanctioning a ₹22.92 Cr refund for FY19 and FY20.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,093.37 Cr (+13.7% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹40.68 Cr (+248.6% YoY).
Gandhar Oil reported FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹4,241.2 Cr and net profit of ₹137.2 Cr.
Gandhar Oil Refinery (India) Limited shared the audio link for its Q4 & FY2026 earnings call held May 27, 2026, at 11:00 AM (IST) via its website.
Gandhar Oil received a favourable customs refund order of ₹17.69 Cr for the 2017-18 period.
Aslesh Ramesh Parekh, Promoter, declared no encumbrances on promoter shares for FY2025-26 under SEBI’s takeover regulations on April 03, 2026.
Gandhar Oil held its Q4 and FY26 earnings conference call on May 27, 2026, reporting consolidated revenue of ₹4,241 Cr and net profit of ₹137 Cr.

Gandhar Oil Refinery (India) Limited’s representatives will participate in Choice Equity Broking Pvt. Ltd.’s virtual ‘InsightX 2026 – Investor Conference’ on June 11, 2026, from 4:00 p.m. to 5:00 p.m.
Gandhar Oil Refinery reported record Q1FY27 results with 92% YoY revenue growth to ₹1,732 Cr and 688% YoY PAT growth to ₹206 Cr, driven by export growth and margin expansion
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,846.56 Cr, net profit to shareholders ₹174.91 Cr (+385.2% YoY).
Gandhar Oil reported Q2FY27 investor presentation showing highest-ever quarterly revenue of ₹1,847 Cr and PAT of ₹186 Cr.
